messages:
anika: Postmortem follow-up: we need a minimal, enforceable plan for canaries that reduces blast radius and surfaces repeats. Focus: micro-containment, clear auto-actions, and recurrence fingerprints.

omar: +1. propose a 'micro-containment' mode: limit to 1% traffic + probe heavy routing for N minutes before any full rollback.

sam: Define exact triggers. Suggest combos: error_rate > 3x (5m), p95 > 2x (5m), fidelity_drop >= 2% on probe-set. If 2/3 hit -> quarantine. If all 3 -> immediate rollback.

harper: Love the combination rule. Also require `gating_config_id` on deploys so postmortems can point to the exact policy used.

anika: Draft gating snippet (JSON) for runtime to consume: 

```
{"gating_config_id":"g-micro-202603","flag":"reply-v3","phases":["0.5%","2%","10%","100%"],"micro_containment_pct":1,"containment_mins":12,"signatures":{"err_mult":3.0,"p95_mult":2.0,"fidelity_drop_pct":2.0},"auto_sequence":["quarantine","fallback_pin","rollback"],"fingerprint_fields":["flag","variant","signature_id"]}
```

omar: Runtime behavior: on 'quarantine' pin 95% to previous variant and route 5% to canary with doubled probe sampling. After containment_mins, if signature persists then run fallback_pin for hold_minutes then rollback.

sam: Telemetry: emit events `guard.fingerprint`, counters `guard.quarantine`, `guard.fallback`, `guard.rollback`, and gauge `guard.quarantine_time`. Also add `fingerprint=sha256(flag|variant|signature_id)` in payload.

harper: Analytics action: store fingerprints and run weekly dedup job that surfaces any fingerprint with >1 occurrence in 90 days. Auto-create review task for owners when recurrence is detected.

anika: Ownership + due dates:
- anika: write RFC + examples (3 business days)
- omar: implement micro-containment + fallback hooks in runtime (2 weeks)
- sam: probe-set + fidelity pipeline + baseline snapshots (7 days)
- harper: recurrence dashboard + weekly job + calendar automation (3 weeks)

infra-bot: NOTE: PRs that change rollout defaults require `./ci/guard_smoke.sh` and must attach `deployment.gating_config_id` to deploy events.

omar: Small UX ask: add `hold_until_approved` flag to gating so teams can block auto-promote. Useful for high-risk releases.

sam: Also add telemetry counter `guard.hold_approved` when humans approve so we can measure how often manual holds are used.

anika: I'll file RFC and tickets now and tag owners. If no objections I will set due dates as above.

harper: ACK. I'll prototype dashboard widgets for recurrence this week.

omar: ACK. starting runtime branch tomorrow.

sam: ACK. prepping probe set and snapshots.

anika: thanks all, will post links when RFC + PRs are up.
